freshnessPolicy: Derived from the mission DAG in this run.
whyNotExpectedValue: No economic prior exists for these missions. Ranking them by an invented expected contribution would be a guess wearing arithmetic.

allocated.title: Verified work sitting on a branch and not in main

waiting.unblockCondition: The founder supplies the V7 or V9 file; part 16 is re-encoded from it and the materializer prints LOSSLESS_VERIFIED against the unmodified manifest.
The founder ranks the operative canon in docs/NORTH_STAR_PRECEDENCE.md. The ranks are parsed from that file, so the conflict graph resolves with no code change.
Any authorized caller records a contract-bound probe younger than the doctor freshness window, after which the state becomes SERVING or NOT_SERVING.
One cleared payment witnessed by a provider reaches durable storage.
A configured provider appears in capabilities:doctor and one real routed call leaves a receipt naming the provider and model.
Each artifact unblocks when its own named condition is met. The index carries the reason per artifact and the gap closes when none is left waiting.

uncertainty: An equal share across actionable missions is a statement that nothing here justifies ranking them, not a claim they are equally valuable.
